## Type of change

- [ ] New entry (or entries)

## For new entries — required evidence

<!-- PRs without this section are closed with a pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] **Bangladesh-connection evidence** (a checkable URL — maintainer profile with location, org page, or a for-Bangladesh product page):
- [ ] **Licence as stated at the source** (or "no licence file" — allowed, flagged):
- [ ] **Canonical URL** (the repo or registry page itself, not a third-party article):
- [ ] Entry line follows the existing style — description ends with a period, licence stated, non-commercial datasets badged `⚠️ non-commercial`:

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [scope and eligibility](docs/scope-and-eligibility.md) and the [curation policy](docs/curation-policy.md).
- [ ] If this adds or moves an entry, I also updated the matching section guide in `docs/sections/` and (when applicable) the `data/*.json` record.
- [ ] I have not copied entries from other Bangladesh lists — I link to them instead.
- [ ] Small and precise: this PR does one thing.
